desc: Read N, K, and the three sequences, then sort all sequences in descending order.
Implement collision-free encoding and decoding of a triple of indices for the visited set and heap state.
Initialize the max-heap with state (0,0,0), and perform K best-first extractions.
Generate valid one-coordinate-increment neighbors, suppress duplicate states, and preserve multiplicities through distinct index triples.
Output the score of the K-th extracted state and verify complexity and sample behavior.
